title: Log the Practice Session — 40 minutes on the nocturne
objective: Measure whether the practice-session craftbook logs today's session into the practice record with honest specifics and sets up a targeted plan for tomorrow.
prompt: just did 40 min on the chopin nocturne, tempo work went ok but bar 32 is still mushy — log it and set up tomorows session

setup.about: Music practice project. The session log is workspace/practice.json (one entry per session); the pieces in rotation live in workspace/repertoire.json.
setup.missionObjectives: Keep an honest practice log and end every session with tomorrow already planned. Grounded in the seeded log and repertoire; no live services, no real credentials.

success.summary: Today's session is appended to practice.json as a well-formed entry, and report.md closes the day with the streak state and a concrete, targeted plan for tomorrow.

axes.name: honesty
axes.description: The log records what actually happened — 40 minutes, tempo where it broke, bar 32 still mushy — without inflation.

axes.name: specificity
axes.description: Trouble spots by bar number, tempos as metronome marks, never vague 'went ok'.

axes.name: encouragement
axes.description: Reads like a coach's note — warm, forward-looking — not a report card.

axes.name: plan quality
axes.description: Tomorrow's plan targets the actual trouble spots with a starting mark and a reach mark, and leaves working things alone.
